# artisanvirt_cluster (Data Source)

Looks up a cluster, with members, quorum and capacity, by id or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "artisanvirt_cluster" "prod" {
  name = "fsn1-prod"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Cluster id. Exactly one of `id` or `name` is required.
- `name` (String) Cluster name.

### Read-Only

- `allocated_memory_mib` (Number)
- `allocated_vcpus` (Number)
- `cpu_cores` (Number) Total CPU cores.
- `description` (String)
- `has_quorum` (Boolean)
- `location` (String)
- `memory_mib` (Number) Total memory.
- `node_ids` (List of String) Member node ids.
- `quorum_mode` (String) `majority` or `qdevice`.
- `status` (String) `creating`, `operational`, `degraded`, `error` or `deleting`.
- `status_message` (String)
- `storage_available_gib` (Number)
- `storage_gib` (Number)
- `storage_strategy` (String) `local`, `replicated` or `shared`.
- `vm_count` (Number)
